items.text: They listened before they drew anything, and the plan fit our routine from the first week.
Weekly updates, no surprises on site, and a kitchen that finally has room for two cooks.
Small flat, big difference. The storage wall alone changed how the whole place feels.
We lived at home through the whole remodel and it never felt chaotic.
The light in the living room is the best part. We did not know the house could feel this open.
Clear budget, clear schedule, and a bathroom we actually enjoy using.
